title: 四十二分钟不是三十分钟达标
premise: 首批数据校验通过，核算恢复步骤耗时及尚未完成的最终验收。
listeningTask: 区分恢复点差距与恢复耗时目标。

lines.en: Restore elapsed time reached forty-two minutes. We started at three, UTC today.
lines.zh: 恢复已耗时四十二分钟，今天UTC三点开始。

lines.en: That's through the initial checked access? Final application acceptance isn't done yet.
lines.zh: 这是到首批经过检查的访问为止？最终应用验收还没完成。

lines.en: Yes, thirty-three minutes restoring and replaying. Nine more minutes for initial checks.
lines.zh: 对，恢复和回放三十三分钟，初步检查又九分钟。

lines.en: Just to confirm, target was thirty, right? The recovery window already exceeded that.
lines.zh: 确认一下，目标是三十分钟，对吧？恢复时间已经超了。

lines.en: Correct. Don't stop the clock retroactively. Remaining reconciliation checks add more elapsed time.
lines.zh: 对，别倒推提前停表，剩余对账检查还会增加耗时。

lines.en: The recovery target still excludes five minutes. That's separate from these forty-two minutes.
lines.zh: 恢复目标仍排除五分钟数据，这与四十二分钟耗时是两回事。

lines.en: Where did the extra time accumulate? Measure download, replay, and validation separately.
lines.zh: 多出来的时间在哪？分别测下载、回放和验证。

lines.en: Download took longer than our rehearsal. Maybe bandwidth limits explain part of it.
lines.zh: 下载比预演久，带宽限制可能解释一部分。

lines.en: What's the ETA for final checks? Call it provisional until jobs finish.
lines.zh: 最终检查预计何时完成？任务结束前只能说暂估。

lines.en: Okay, roughly another twenty minutes estimated. No completed recovery-time claim before acceptance.
lines.zh: 好，估计再二十分钟左右，验收前不宣称恢复耗时已最终确定。
